curl -s -X POST "https://slack.com/api/conversations.history" -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" --data "token=<TOKEN>&channel=C_ENG&limit=100" | python3 -c "
import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
if not d.get('ok'): print('ERROR:', d.get('error'), d.get('error_summary')); sys.exit(1)
for m in d['messages']:
    ts=m.get('ts')
    text=m.get('text','')
    subs=m.get('subtype')
    print('---', ts, '|', subs or '', '|', m.get('user',''), '|', text[:150].replace(chr(10),' '))
    react=m.get('reactions')
    if react:
        print('   reactions:', [(r['name'], r.get('users')) for r in react])
"
